results.note: HEAD, dribbled chunks with trailers: the head only
GET, the same: chunks and trailers
HEAD, chunked without delay: the head only
HEAD, SSE: the head only, the connection kept for the next request
HEAD, SSE with closeConnection: the head only, then close
HEAD forwarded to a dribbled response: aggregated, chunked dropped, content-length: 0
HEAD forwarded to an SSE response, asking for a stream: the streamed head relayed, no body
